notes.title: Updated from ver. 1.0.2 to ver. 1.0.3.
notes.content:
Updated from ver. 1.0.2 to ver. 1.0.3.
As a result of this change, the Japanese characters that remained when clicking the save, load, and title buttons in the main game have been corrected to English.
In the Japanese environment, some expressions in the text have been corrected.
